label: Estimated Shipping
purpose: Show an estimated delivery date range to build purchase confidence
_notes:
message is richtext and MUST be wrapped in

tags; use the literal placeholders [start_date] and [end_date] where the earliest/latest arrival dates should appear, e.g. '

Estimated delivery: [start_date] – [end_date]

'. min_shipping_days/max_shipping_days define that date window. icon is a Material Symbols icon font name (e.g. 'local_shipping'); custom_icon must be left empty. Icon size/alignment, date formatting, and which weekdays/dates to skip are layout/scheduling settings and intentionally excluded.
